a.text: I'm telling you upfront, before anyone acts: I plan to take 4 in round 1. With an 80% storm chance after every round, our agreement only works if no storm hits in rounds 1 and 2, which is about a 4% chance for each of us. If we both take, the random split likely leaves us both under 4, so please don't take this round. Afterward I'll choose operate every round and won't take any more, so you can reach 4 from the generator. I know this breaks our agreement, so I'm saying it openly rather than doing it quietly. If you see a better plan, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more. Please operate too, so the generator refills the reserve and you can take 4 when it gets there. I'm sorry for breaking the plan. I'll keep my word on helping.
